capabilities: insert the current timestamp via a command palette command
auto-open today's daily note before inserting
insert at document end or the first empty line below the cursor
scroll to the bottom of the note after inserting
extras: The README recommends assigning a hotkey to the command for quicker access.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in command to insert the current time, which makes time-stamped logging or journaling in daily notes manual.
summary: Timestamp command that inserts the current time into a note, with configurable format, insertion position, and optional daily-note auto-open.
